title: Make Kaite workload capabilities explicit and schedulable
intent: Evolve Kaite's existing hardware plus slim/full image substrate into a truthful capability-set contract. Preserve current image and runtime interfaces while making the existing data-science, training, orchestration, and serving layers explicit in image identity, supervisor validation, Buildkite agent tags, pipeline examples, CI/release metadata, and documentation. Do not add a new framework or a Cartesian image matrix.
stop_conditions: Do not re-enable accelerator auto-release without matching hosts
